nodes.title: SG-8.3.1 Rewrite the repo-root context.md to the real stack
nodes.body:
Context: context.md still holds the README-only text (Purpose, Entry points, Workflows, Scan meta, Residual unknowns, Traceability index, UNKNOWN stack lines). The helpers contextModulePaths (game/frontend/src/lib/contextDoc.ts) and missingPaths, missingTerms and STACK_TERMS (game/frontend/src/lib/docsCheck.ts) already exist, as do both context.md tests in game/frontend/tests/contextDoc.test.ts. Desired behavior: context.md describes the real stack and modules. Expected result: both context.md unit tests pass. Why: the docs must match the code. Devion writes context.md itself from the Act and Verify tickets, so the Act and Verify agents do not edit it.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the repo-root context.md, when missingTerms runs with STACK_TERMS, then it returns [].
- Given the module table rows, when contextModulePaths reads them, then it includes game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/, and every path exists on disk.
- Given context.md, when searched, then it has no 'hello Worldseed', 'Traceability index', 'Frameworks: UNKNOWN' or UNKNOWN-main entry-point row.


## Scope
- In scope: Stack section with TypeScript, Phaser 3.90, React, Zustand, Radix, Vitest and the Go backend marked out of scope
- In scope: Module table with backticked paths for game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md, backend/
- In scope: Removal of Purpose, Entry points, Workflows, Scan meta, Residual unknowns and Traceability sections
- Out of scope: backend/ changes
- Out of scope: GDD content
- Out of scope: game behaviour
- Preserve: Phaser pin ~3.90.0
- Preserve: existing helper exports and signatures


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0; the phaser-pin guard test must keep passing
- backend/ (Go) and the contribution/round API are out of scope
- npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/
- No test deleted or skipped
- No source file over 200 lines


## Definition of done
- Both context.md tests in game/frontend/tests/contextDoc.test.ts pass
- Typecheck passes in game/frontend


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · context.md has a real module table and no README-only text
nodes.body:
Context: contextModulePaths extracts backticked game/ and backend/ paths from table rows. Desired behavior: the table covers game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/, all existing, and the Purpose, Entry points, Workflows, Scan meta, Residual unknowns and Traceability sections are removed. Expected result: the module-paths test passes. Why: remove misleading text.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the table rows, when contextModulePaths runs, then the result contains game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/.
- Given context.md, when matched against /hello Worldseed|Traceability index/, then there is no match, and every listed path exists.


## Scope
- In scope: Module table and removal of stale sections
- Out of scope: Stack wording
- Preserve: contextModulePaths behaviour


## Technical constraints
- Every path named must exist


## Definition of done
- Module paths and stale text test passes
